review: I was confirmed at fourteen like everyone here and I have not thought about it since, and I want to be clear that I did not come looking for religion. I make playlists for the highland road with tourists asleep in the van. "Kitchen Light at Six" has been on the F-road playlist since March. My brother drowned at nineteen and the entire country said the correct careful things and none of them were words. There is a thing that happens when you switch the engine off out there at two in the morning in June and nobody has ever given me a word for it, and this album does not give me one either, it just does it. Five stars.
